S.FORM: Malu ka hiyi=su?
Malu ka hiyisu?
S.PHON: maɮu ka ħəjisu
S.TRANSL: Is your body well? How are you?

S.FORM: deha huliŋ kumu gaga
deha huling kumu gaga
S.PHON: dəħa ħoɮiŋ kumu ɣaɣa
S.TRANSL: Those two dogs of Kumu's

S.FORM: Saman 'u, mawsa=nami Tehaypaq da.
Saman 'u, mawsanami Tehaypaq da.
S.PHON: saman ʔu mawsanami təħajpaq da
S.TRANSL: As for tomorrow, we will go to Taipei.

S.FORM: Sapah=na 'u, hebaraw ka patas=na.
Sapahna 'u, hebaraw ka patasna.
S.PHON: sapaħna ʔu ħəbaɾaw ka patasna
S.TRANSL: As for his house, there are many books.

S.FORM: Laqi gaga 'u, malu (ka hiya).
Laqi gaga 'u, malu ka hiya.
S.PHON: ɮaqə ɣaɣa ʔu maɮu ka ħəja
S.TRANSL: As for that child, s/he is good.

S.FORM: Kumu 'u, b-en-arig=na laqi=na ka patas niyi.
Kumu 'u, benarigna laqina ka patas niyi.
S.PHON: kumu ʔu bənaɾiɣna ɮaqəna ka patas niji
S.TRANSL: As for Kumu, she bought this book for her child.

S.FORM: Deha laqi niyi 'u, tege'ima ka sewayi=su?
Deha laqi niyi 'u, tege'ima ka sewayisu?
S.PHON: dəħa ɮaqə niji ʔu təɣəʔima ka səwajisu
S.TRANSL: As for these two children, which is your younger sibling?

S.FORM: Ga reŋag-an yudaw ga ka lupuŋ 'u pena'ah 'amirika (ka lupuŋ gaga).
Ga rengagan yudaw ga ka lupung 'u pena'ah 'amirika ka lupung gaga.
S.PHON: ɣa ɾəŋaɣan judaw ɣa ka ɮupuŋ ʔu pənaʔaħ ʔamiɾika ka ɮupuŋ ɣaɣa
S.TRANSL: The guest to whom that Yudaw is talking over there is from America.

S.FORM: Ga r-em-eŋaw lupuŋ ka yudaw ga 'u, pena'ah 'Amirika.
Ga remengaw lupung ka yudaw ga 'u, pena'ah 'Amirika.
S.PHON: ɣa ɾəməŋaw ɮupuŋ ka judaw ɣa ʔu pənaʔaħ ʔamiɾika
S.TRANSL: Yudaw who is speaking to a/the guest is from America.

S.FORM: Sepeg-un rubiq ka patas 'u, b-en-egay tama=na.
Sepegun rubiq ka patas 'u, benegay tamana.
S.PHON: səpəɣun ɾubəq ka patas ʔu bənəɣaj tamana
S.TRANSL: Her father gave (her) this book which Rubiq will read.

S.FORM: Ga reŋag-an yudaw ga ka lupuŋ 'u, m-en-egay patas rebiq-an.
Ga rengagan yudaw ga ka lupung 'u, menegay patas rebiqan.
S.PHON: ɣa ɾəŋaɣan judaw ɣa ka ɮupuŋ ʔu mənəɣaj patas ɾəbəqan
S.TRANSL: The guest to whom Yudaw is talking to will give a/the book to Rubiq.

S.FORM: Saw 'adi mpeke-geruŋ ka peratu 'u, berig-un=mu.
Saw 'adi mpekegerung ka peratu 'u, berigunmu.
S.PHON: saw ʔadi m̩pəkəɣəɾuŋ ka pəɾatu ʔu bəɾiɣunmu
S.TRANSL: I will buy such a plate as will not break.

S.FORM: Saw mpe-takur ka laqi 'u, pelekuh-un=na da.
Saw mpetakur ka laqi 'u, pelekuhunna da.
S.PHON: saw m̩pətakuɾ ka ɮaqə ʔu pəɮəkoħonna da
S.TRANSL: When the child is likely to stumble, he supports the child.
He supported the child who was likely to stumble.

S.FORM: Saw 'adi mpeke-geruŋ ka peratu 'u, seku-'un=mu kulu.
Saw 'adi mpekegerung ka peratu 'u, seku'unmu kulu.
S.PHON: saw ʔadi m̩pəkəɣəɾuŋ ka pəɾatu ʔu səkuʔunmu kuɮu
S.TRANSL: I put the plate in a box lest it should break.

S.FORM: Wada qeduriq ka se'diq [p-en-huqil rebiq-an].
Wada qeduriq ka se'diq penhuqil rebiqan.
S.PHON: wada qəduɾəq ka səʔdəq pənħoqəɮ ɾəbəqan
S.TRANSL: The person who killed Rubiq escaped away.

S.FORM: Wada qeduriq ka [p-en-huqil rebiq-an ka se'diq].
Wada qeduriq ka penhuqil rebiqan ka se'diq.
S.PHON: wada qəduɾəq ka pənħoqəɮ ɾəbəqan ka səʔdəq
S.TRANSL: The person who killed Rubiq escaped away.

S.FORM: S-em-en-teruŋ=ku se'diq [m-en-uway patas rebiq-an].
Sementerungku se'diq menuway patas rebiqan.
S.PHON: səməntəɾuŋku səʔdəq mənuwaj patas ɾəbəqan
S.TRANSL: I met [the man who gave Rubiq a book].

S.FORM: S-em-en-teruŋ=ku [m-en-uway patas rebiq-an ka se'diq].
Sementerungku menuway patas rebiqan ka se'diq.
S.PHON: səməntəɾuŋku mənuwaj patas ɾəbəqan ka səʔdəq
S.TRANSL: I met [the man who gave Rubiq a book].

S.FORM: Adi mpe-sepug ka laqi 'u, seku-i haya.
Adi mpesepug ka laqi 'u, sekui haya.
S.PHON: adi m̩pəsəpuɣ ka ɮaqə ʔu səkui ħaja
S.TRANSL: As the child will not read, put it away.

S.FORM: M-uduh siyaŋ ka sehiga 'u, 'eme-'ima ka m-eniq hiya?
Muduh siyang ka sehiga 'u, 'eme'ima ka meniq hiya?
S.PHON: mudoħ sijaŋ ka səħəɣa ʔu ʔəməʔima ka mənəq ħəja
S.TRANSL: When they roasted meat, who were there?

S.FORM: M-iyah q-em-ita tema-'an ka rubiq 'u, wada ŋaŋut ka tama.
Miyah qemita tema'an ka rubiq 'u, wada ngangut ka tama.
S.PHON: mijaħ qəmita təmaʔan ka ɾubəq ʔu wada ŋaŋut ka tama
S.TRANSL: Though rubiq came to see father, father went outside.

S.FORM: M-iyah=su hini 'u, me-qaras=ku.
Miyahsu hini 'u, meqarasku.
S.PHON: mijaħsu ħəni ʔu məqaɾasku
S.TRANSL: If you come, I would be glad.

S.FORM: T-em-egesa 'uyas kelemukan ka tiwaŋ 'u, t-em-egesa 'uyas nihuŋ ka daway 'uri.
Temegesa 'uyas kelemukan ka tiwang 'u, temegesa 'uyas nihung ka daway 'uri.
S.PHON: təməɣəsa ʔujas kəɮəmukan ka tiwaŋ ʔu təməɣəsa ʔujas nəħoŋ ka dawaj ʔuɾi
S.TRANSL: Ciwang taught Taiwanese songs, and Daway taught Japanese songs.

S.FORM: Pe-kedus-un=ta=na ka 'ita 'u, m-en-da huway yisu kirisuto tehawlaŋ.
Pekedusuntana ka 'ita 'u, menda huway yisu kirisuto tehawlang.
S.PHON: pəkədusuntana ka ʔita ʔu mənda ħowaj jisu kiɾisuto təħawɮaŋ
S.TRANSL: That we are made to live by him, it is through the grace of Lord Jesus Christ.

S.FORM: M-usa sapah rubiq ka kumu 'u, me-kela ka rubiq.
Musa sapah rubiq ka kumu 'u, mekela ka rubiq.
S.PHON: musa sapaħ ɾubəq ka kumu ʔu məkəɮa ka ɾubəq
S.TRANSL: Rubiq knows that Kumu went to Rubiq's house.

S.source: PDF p. 83; printed p. 78; duplicate-labeled example (27)
S.FORM: [P-en-huqil rebiq-an ka se'diq] 'u, wada qeduriq.
Penhuqil rebiqan ka se'diq 'u, wada qeduriq.
S.PHON: pənħoqəɮ ɾəbəqan ka səʔdəq ʔu wada qəduɾəq
S.TRANSL: The person who killed Rubiq escaped.
